links.outcome: Clinician-rated usability (System Usability Scale) of ML dashboard prototype in simulated evaluations
links.effect: Mean System Usability Scale score 82.5 (SD 10.5) despite usability problems, which mostly concerned presentation of information and functionality.
links.quote: Despite the usability problems, participants rated the system highly on the System Usability Scale (mean score, 82.5; standard deviation, 10.5).

links.outcome: Usability rating of an interface designed from clinician needs and preferences
links.effect: Designing with user needs and preferences produced an interface clinicians rated as highly usable (SUS mean 82.5).
links.quote: Incorporating user needs and preferences into the design of a machine learning dashboard results in a display interface that clinicians rate as highly usable.

unlisted_practices: Card sorting and focus groups to characterize clinician workflows and needs for a risk-prediction display
Iterative low- to high-fidelity prototyping with think-aloud testing

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the usability and workflow integration of an ML dashboard using user-centered design and simulated clinical evaluations with clinicians.
